neighbours.label: a discourse pivot that sets up a question: sentence-initial 'So' after a framing statement, or the comma closing an 'if it isn't X' clause before 'what ...?'; the same clauses leading into a plain statement stay lower
fire: Everyone talks about the metaverse these days. So, what exactly is the metaverse?
If it isn't the heat that wilts the roses, what is it?
Cloud computing has become a buzz-word in every boardroom. So, what does it actually mean?
Well, if it isn't a lack of sleep, what causes the afternoon slump?
Minimalism is a trend in every magazine right now. So, what is minimalism really?
If the noise isn't coming from the engine, where is it coming from?
Blockchain is mentioned in every investor pitch today. So, what is a blockchain?
But if fasting isn't a modern fad, where did the idea come from?
quiet: Everyone talked about the metaverse last year, and then the hype faded away.
When it isn't too hot, the roses bloom well into the autumn.
Cloud computing has saved our boardroom a lot of money on servers.
A lack of sleep usually causes the afternoon slump for most office workers.
Minimalism appeared in many magazines last year, along with houseplants.
The noise was coming from the engine, so we stopped at a garage.
Blockchain was mentioned in one investor pitch, but nobody asked about it.
Fasting is an old practice found in many religious traditions.

notes: Card: peaks on ' So' / 'So' x22 before 'what', and on ',' after 'if it isn't X'; logit effect promotes question, how, What. Probe: 'buzz-word in every company. So, what exactly' 0.419, 'If it isn't dehydration that causes cramps, what does?' 0.416; but 'So we hired a data team' also 0.419 (the So fires before the question appears) and 'The symptoms are real. So what can' only 0.143; 'If it isn't raining tomorrow, we will' 0.029. Near misses therefore drop the setup frame, not just the question.
